reason: A long-term memory plugin that stores categorized global or project-scoped records locally, exposes memory management tools, and injects relevant memories into new agent sessions.

summaries.zh: 用于将用户偏好、项目事实、会话摘要和可复用知识持久化到本地，并在新会话开始时注入相关记忆的长期记忆插件。
summaries.en: A long-term memory plugin that persists preferences, project facts, session summaries, and reusable knowledge locally and injects relevant memories at the start of new sessions.

capabilities: Persists user preferences, project facts, summaries, and reusable knowledge to local JSON files
Provides tools to read, search, write, and delete stored memories
Injects selected stored memories into the first agent step of new sessions
